processing.english: Every published English card reviewed and replaced where needed
processing.sourceAccess: Fresh YouTube identity/embedding/duration checks at publication. New source-frame retrieval eventually hit YouTube sign-in/bot protection; cached audio, frames and titles retained.
processing.music: Seven vocal/music performances remain unpublished; no paid AI requested and no unrelated on-screen instructions assigned fake speech timings.
